meta.status: PROPOSAL. Token set v3, a draft that evolves token set v2 (src/app/globals.css); nothing is applied until Yazid approves it. Every token's usage begins KEPT, CHANGED or NEW, and NEEDS A RULING where it departs from an existing ruling.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: KEPT. The canvas: page ground and the navigation's ground. Warm off-white.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: KEPT. The product surface: tables, sheets, fields, dialogs, menus. Use it only where an object needs to stand apart from the canvas.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: KEPT. Quiet wells, the hover ground of rows and quiet buttons, the segmented control's track, skeleton blocks. Never a resting card.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: NEW. The pressed ground of neutral controls (secondary and quiet buttons, rows). Never a resting surface. ink-1 12.0:1, ink-2 5.8:1.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: KEPT. Primary text: titles, body, values. 14.0:1 on surface-0, 14.6:1 on surface-1, 12.9:1 on surface-2, 12.4:1 on pintar-primary-soft.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: KEPT. Secondary text: descriptions, help text, table headers, unselected tabs and nav items. 6.8:1 on surface-0, 7.1:1 on surface-1, 6.3:1 on surface-2, 6.0:1 on pintar-primary-soft.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: KEPT. Metadata, captions, eyebrows, placeholders. 5.3:1 on surface-0, 5.5:1 on surface-1, 4.9:1 on surface-2, 4.7:1 on pintar-primary-soft.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: NEW. Text and icons of a disabled control: 3.2:1 on surface-2 and 3.6:1 on surface-1. WCAG exempts disabled controls, but PINTAR keeps them readable. A disabled control always has its reason written next to it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: KEPT. The one hairline: dividers, table row rules, the navigation's edge, panel outlines. Decorative separation only; it never outlines a field.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: KEPT. Secondary button outlines and the segmented control's selected segment. These have text labels that identify them, so the outline only groups them. 1.6:1.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 3). The outline of every field, checkbox, radio and switch: 3.5:1 on surface-1, 3.4:1 on surface-0, 3.1:1 on surface-2, meeting WCAG 1.4.11. Replaces line-strong on fields, which is 1.6:1 today.

tokens.name: pintar-primary
tokens.usage: KEPT. PINTAR green. The one primary action, links, the focus ring, the selected tab's underline, a checked control. 7.4:1 on surface-1, 7.1:1 on surface-0. Approved 16 Sep 2026. It is also the colour of the PINTAR wordmark (canonical, 5 Oct), CMYK 84 43 65 29 in print.

tokens.name: pintar-primary-ink
tokens.usage: KEPT. Text and icons on pintar-primary: 7.4:1.

tokens.name: pintar-primary-soft
tokens.usage: KEPT. The selected ground: the current navigation item, a selected table row, the QR tile. pintar-primary text on it is 6.3:1. Never success.

tokens.name: pintar-primary-hover
tokens.usage: KEPT. The primary button on hover: white text 9.0:1.

tokens.name: pintar-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: NEW. The primary button while pressed: white text 10.9:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: KEPT (named: v2 writes the primary directly in :focus-visible). The keyboard focus outline, 2px solid with a 2px offset, on every focusable thing. 7.1:1 on surface-0, 6.5:1 on surface-2. It is never removed, and it never changes colour by component.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: KEPT. Success: a real, confirmed change («✓ Tersimpan»), a verified result, something now available. Always with ✓ and a word, because it differs from PINTAR green by only 1.2:1 in lightness. Rare by design. 6.1:1 on surface-1, 5.3:1 on status-ok-soft.

tokens.name: status-ok-soft
tokens.usage: KEPT. The ground of a success result line or banner. Never a resting decoration.

tokens.name: status-attention
tokens.usage: KEPT. Attention: something needs a look, and nothing is broken and nobody did anything wrong. 5.7:1 on surface-1, 4.9:1 on status-attention-soft.

tokens.name: status-attention-soft
tokens.usage: KEPT. The ground of an attention banner or badge.

tokens.name: status-blocked
tokens.usage: KEPT. Error and destructive: an action failed or is refused, or a destructive confirmation. 7.5:1 on surface-1, 6.1:1 on status-blocked-soft, white text 7.5:1. Never on a person or a learner's result.

tokens.name: status-blocked-soft
tokens.usage: KEPT. The ground of an error result line or banner.

tokens.name: status-blocked-hover
tokens.usage: NEW. The destructive confirm button on hover: white text 9.3:1.

tokens.name: status-blocked-pressed
tokens.usage: NEW. The destructive confirm button while pressed: white text 10.4:1.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: KEPT. Information: neutral news that changes nothing yet. 7.1:1 on surface-1, 6.0:1 on status-info-soft.

tokens.name: status-info-soft
tokens.usage: KEPT. The ground of an information banner or badge.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 5). Behind a dialog or a drawer only, to say the page beneath is waiting.

tokens.name: context
tokens.usage: NEW role, NEEDS A RULING (question 12). The accent, without a new hue: a mode that changes what the screen means (MODE PERAGAAN; a preview of what a learner sees) is one full-width band in deep ink, so it can never be read as a status or an action. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: context-ink
tokens.usage: NEW role, NEEDS A RULING (question 12). Text and its link on the context band. 14.0:1.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: NEW role (Dr Gladys, accepted 5 Oct), no new colour. The header row of a table: its own quiet ground, under ink-2 labels at 600 (6.3:1). It is never a row colour.

tokens.name: table-row
tokens.usage: NEW role (Dr Gladys, accepted 5 Oct), no new colour. Odd body rows: the table's own white.

tokens.name: table-row-alt
tokens.usage: NEW role (Dr Gladys, accepted 5 Oct), no new colour. Even body rows: the canvas tint, 1.04:1 against white, enough to follow a long row and too quiet to read as meaning. Every text colour keeps its contrast on it (ink-3 5.3:1).

tokens.name: table-row-hover
tokens.usage: NEW role (Dr Gladys, accepted 5 Oct), no new colour. A row that opens, under the pointer: one step darker than either stripe, so it can't be taken for one. ink-3 4.52:1, just above the floor: nothing quieter than ink-3 is allowed in a table.

tokens.name: table-row-selected
tokens.usage: NEW role (Dr Gladys, accepted 5 Oct), no new colour. A selected row, whatever its stripe, with a 3 px pintar-primary edge and its checked box: selection never rests on the tint alone.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: KEPT (v2 hero 36). One per page at most: a verdict a stranger reads first, or a welcome.

styles.name: t-page
styles.usage: KEPT (v2 page 30). The page title, one per page. Becomes t-page-compact below 640px.

styles.name: t-page-compact
styles.usage: NEW (replaces literal 26, 27 and 32 px phone sizes). The page title below 640px. It replaces the literal 26, 27 and 32px phone headings.

styles.name: t-section
styles.usage: CHANGED, NEEDS A RULING (question 4): v2 subhead 22 and section 24 become one 22. A section heading inside a page. Merges v2 subhead 22 and section 24.

styles.name: t-subsection
styles.usage: CHANGED, NEEDS A RULING (question 4): v2 card 17 and course 20 become one 18. A subsection, a panel or dialog title, a course line. Merges v2 card 17 and course 20.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Murid membaca materi, lalu mengerjakan soal latihan.
styles.usage: KEPT. All interface text: sentences, field values, buttons at 44px.

styles.name: t-prose
styles.sample: Pecahan senilai adalah pecahan yang nilainya sama walaupun pembilang dan penyebutnya berbeda.
styles.usage: KEPT (v2 prose leading 1.65). Sustained reading only (a lesson, an explanation), at 64ch at most.

styles.name: t-small
styles.usage: CHANGED, NEEDS A RULING (question 4): v2 meta 14 kept, fine 13 folds into it. Secondary body, help text, metadata and captions, in ink-2 or ink-3. Merges v2 meta 14 and fine 13: PINTAR has no 13px text in v3.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: KEPT (v2 meta 14 at 600). Field labels, table headers, button text at 36px and below, badge text. Labels are never in capitals.

styles.name: t-eyebrow
styles.usage: KEPT. The only uppercase style, and the only 12px text. One short line above a title, to name its context.

styles.name: t-stat
styles.usage: NEW name. Replaces the literal 32 px of today's .pin-metric figure (2 px smaller) and sits on the page title's size. One figure that is the point of its block, always followed by what it is out of and what it means. Tabular figures.

styles.name: t-stat-small
styles.usage: NEW name, kept size (22). A figure inside a row of figures, or in a table summary. Tabular figures.

styles.name: t-identifier
styles.usage: KEPT face and weight: v2 .pin-mono (IBM Plex Mono 500, tabular), now named and given a size. PINTAR IDs, codes and references. Never broken across lines. The certificate keeps its own sizes for its number (15) and verification link (12.5): the certificate is frozen.

styles.name: t-stem
styles.usage: KEPT. The question a learner is answering: the most-read text in PINTAR. Kept outside the ladder on purpose.

spacing.note: A 4px base, used in 8s. Unchanged from v2.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: KEPT. An icon and its text; a label and its count.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: KEPT. Inside a control group: buttons in a row, a badge and its text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: KEPT. A label or help text and its field; table cell padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: KEPT. Between fields in a form; table cell padding (horizontal); the small-screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: KEPT. Between groups of fields; panel padding; the desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: KEPT. Between a page header and its first section; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: KEPT. The page's top padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: KEPT. Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: KEPT. The page's bottom padding; the space before a page's quiet footer.

radius.note: Four steps. v2 radius-1 (8) is radius-md, v2 radius-2 (12) is radius-lg, and v2's literal 6px goes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 7): v2 has only 8, 12 and pill; replaces the literal 6 px. Checkboxes, skeleton blocks, a keyboard key. Tags moved to pill after the 4 Oct references.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: KEPT value, renamed from radius-1. Buttons, fields, menus, tooltips, the segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: KEPT value, renamed from radius-2. Panels, table frames, dialogs, drawers' inner corners. The largest radius in PINTAR.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: KEPT. Every small label (status badges, tags) and the switch track. Never a button or a field (question 13).

shadow.note: NEEDS A RULING (question 5). v2 has no shadow tokens by design: hairlines and grounds, not elevation. Proposed only for layers that float over the page. Small blur, no backdrop filter, cheap on school hardware.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 5): v2 has no shadow tokens by design. Menus, tooltips, a select's open list: small layers anchored to a control.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 5): v2 has no shadow tokens by design. Dialogs and drawers, over the scrim.

size.note: Control heights, icon sizes, the shell's measures and the content widths.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: CHANGED: 40 → 44. The default height of every button, field and select, and every row action's hit area: PINTAR's 44 px target. It replaces v2's 40 px .pin-btn and .pin-input, the question navigator's 34 and the question bar's 32.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: KEPT value, renamed from control-h. Sign-in fields and actions, and the primary action on a learner's own surface.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: KEPT value, renamed from control-h-big. The class-card path, for young children typing a card number.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: NEW. Visual height of a compact button in a dense table toolbar. Its hit area is still 44px, through padding around it.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: NEW. An icon inside a badge or beside 14px text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: NEW. The default icon: buttons, navigation, fields.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: NEW. An icon that stands alone in an empty state or an alert.

tokens.name: shell-nav
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 1). The expanded left navigation, at 1280px and up.

tokens.name: shell-rail
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 1). The collapsed staff navigation: icons, each with its name as a tooltip and an accessible name, from 1024 to 1279px or when the reader collapses it. Learners never get a rail.

tokens.name: shell-bar
tokens.usage: KEPT value (the 56 px header), now named. The top bar below 1024px, and the public and focus shells at every width. v2's header height.

tokens.name: measure-auth
tokens.usage: KEPT. The sign-in form on a wide screen.

tokens.name: measure-narrow
tokens.usage: KEPT. One task: sign-in, verification, a short form.

tokens.name: measure-read
tokens.usage: KEPT. Reading and forms: a lesson, a settings page.

tokens.name: measure-stage
tokens.usage: KEPT. Tables and overviews: the widest any content goes.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: KEPT (v2 measure). A paragraph's line length.

tokens.name: wordmark-nav
tokens.usage: NEW (canonical wordmark, 5 Oct). The wordmark's cap height in the staff navigation, about 99 px wide. Clear space there is at least half of it, which the navigation's 16 px padding gives.

tokens.name: wordmark-bar
tokens.usage: NEW (canonical wordmark, 5 Oct). The wordmark's cap height in a top bar (learner, focus, public, and staff under 1024 px), about 88 px wide.

tokens.name: wordmark-standalone
tokens.usage: NEW (canonical wordmark, 5 Oct). The wordmark's cap height alone above a task (sign-in, the lock, an error page), about 132 px wide, with its full clear space.

tokens.name: wordmark-min
tokens.usage: NEW (canonical wordmark, 5 Oct). The smallest the wordmark is ever drawn on screen: a 12 px cap height, about 66 px wide. In print, 15 mm wide. Below that, write PINTAR in the text face instead.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: KEPT value, now named. Every line in PINTAR: dividers, outlines, field borders.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: KEPT value, now named. The focus ring, with a 2px offset.

tokens.name: border-selected
tokens.usage: KEPT value (the tab underline), now named. The selected tab's underline and a field's error edge (drawn inside, so nothing moves).

duration.note: Motion stays as v2 rules it (colour and opacity, duration-base 160 ms, nothing under reduced motion) until Yazid rules on question 8. duration-fast, duration-slow and ease-exit are proposals only.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 8); until ruled, every transition uses duration-base. Hover and press colour, a checkbox's tick, a layer leaving.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: KEPT (v2 motion-fast). A state change: a tab, a segment, a result line appearing.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 8); until ruled, every transition uses duration-base. A layer entering: a dialog, a drawer, a menu. The longest motion in PINTAR.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: KEPT value (the 0.9 s pin-denyut pulse), now named. One cycle of the working dot while something is in flight. Off under reduced motion, where the dot stays still.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: NEW. Everything that enters or changes.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 8). A layer leaving.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: NEW. A sticky table header or first column; the top bar.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: NEW. The left navigation.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: NEW. Menus and tooltips.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: NEW. The scrim, dialogs and drawers.

breakpoint.note: New in v3: two boundaries replace v2's 560 and 640px. Content decides inside a page (container queries); these decide the shell.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: CHANGED: 640 was the gutter step; it now also ends the phone band (v2: 560). Small below, medium from here: the gutter goes from 16 to 24px and page titles from compact to full.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 1). The left navigation appears, as a rail; below, the top bar and the menu drawer.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: NEW, NEEDS A RULING (question 1). The navigation expands to shell-nav by default.
